headline: Mooring, Linn Mercy Flare as Stonecradle Divides
war_summary: Since the last filing Mooring County has quickened to six changes in two hours and thirteen on the day about Wiccwalk and the Wind Hills, latest at the filing hour, standing eleven Warden to one Colonial after more than seventy-eight hundred Colonial and sixty-five hundred Warden casualties on the day. Linn Mercy has surged likewise to six changes in two hours and thirteen on the day centred on Lathair, latest within the hour, standing one Warden to ten Colonial with day losses above twenty-two hundred Colonial and fifty-two hundred Warden. Stonecradle adds three changes in two hours and fourteen on the day about World's End, the Cord and Trammel Pool, latest within the hour, now divided five Warden to four Colonial amid heavy day tolls. Stlican Shelf shows no change in two hours after nine in six and twenty-five on the day about the Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch, last turning about two hours ago at eight Warden to one Colonial. Weathered Expanse with thirty-two changes on the day and Fisherman's Row with thirty-nine show no change in two hours, both last turning mid-afternoon, while Nevish Line reports sharp casualties without a recorded base change.
